description: Election Commission Declare that L.B.N. Siripala was elected as the member of the Miniwangoda Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Minuwangoda Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for declaring a selected member to fill a vacancy caused by death, which falls under election-related matters and procedures.
